SessionStart.command: sh -c 'if ! command -v entire >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec entire hooks antigravity session-start'

hooks.command: sh -c 'if ! command -v entire >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec entire hooks antigravity pre-tool-use'

PreInvocation.command: sh -c 'if ! command -v entire >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec entire hooks antigravity pre-invocation'

Stop.command: sh -c 'if ! command -v entire >/dev/null 2>&1; then exit 0; fi; exec entire hooks antigravity stop'

SessionStart.command: sh -c '_p="${FORGIX_CLI_PATH:-}"; if [ -z "$_p" ]; then _d="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-${HOME:+$HOME/.config}}"; case "$_d" in /*) [ -f "$_d/forgix/cli-path.antigravity" ] && IFS= read -r _p < "$_d/forgix/cli-path.antigravity" ;; esac; fi; if [ -z "$_p" ]; then case "${HOME:-}" in /*) _p="$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/forgix/dist/forgix.mjs" ;; esac; fi; case "$_p" in /*) if [ -f "$_p" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec node "$_p" hook antigravity session-start; fi ;; esac; printf "%s\n" "{\"injectSteps\":[{\"systemMessage\":{\"systemMessage\":\"Forgix lifecycle hooks require Node and a pinned installed skill bundle (v2). Run Forgix init (or set FORGIX_CLI_PATH) and reload before BUILD.\"}}]}"; exit 0'

hooks.command: sh -c '_p="${FORGIX_CLI_PATH:-}"; if [ -z "$_p" ]; then _d="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-${HOME:+$HOME/.config}}"; case "$_d" in /*) [ -f "$_d/forgix/cli-path.antigravity" ] && IFS= read -r _p < "$_d/forgix/cli-path.antigravity" ;; esac; fi; if [ -z "$_p" ]; then case "${HOME:-}" in /*) _p="$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/forgix/dist/forgix.mjs" ;; esac; fi; case "$_p" in /*) if [ -f "$_p" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec node "$_p" hook antigravity pre-tool-use; fi ;; esac; printf "%s\n" "{}"; exit 0'

PostInvocation.command: sh -c '_p="${FORGIX_CLI_PATH:-}"; if [ -z "$_p" ]; then _d="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-${HOME:+$HOME/.config}}"; case "$_d" in /*) [ -f "$_d/forgix/cli-path.antigravity" ] && IFS= read -r _p < "$_d/forgix/cli-path.antigravity" ;; esac; fi; if [ -z "$_p" ]; then case "${HOME:-}" in /*) _p="$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/forgix/dist/forgix.mjs" ;; esac; fi; case "$_p" in /*) if [ -f "$_p" ] && command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec node "$_p" hook antigravity post-invocation; fi ;; esac; printf "%s\n" "{}"; exit 0'
